summary: Normalisation means splitting data into tables so each fact is stored once.
points: Repeated values, such as a customer's city on every order, can drift out of step.
Give each kind of thing its own table with a primary key.
Link tables with foreign keys rather than copying values.
A many-to-many relationship gets its own linking table, like enrolments.

example.explanation: Orders store only customer_id. The name and city live in one place, so one update fixes them everywhere.
